presentation.summary: Preserve evidence, gather reliable information and convert findings into corrective action after a non-fatal workplace incident.
presentation.situation: A worker has a minor injury after equipment unexpectedly moved. The area is stable and immediate medical needs have been addressed.
presentation.objective: Make five professional safety decisions as conditions change.
knownFacts: A worker has a minor injury after equipment unexpectedly moved. The area is stable and immediate medical needs have been addressed.

work_authorization_record.title: Scene Preservation Record
work_authorization_record.summary: A worker has received first aid after unexpected equipment movement and the immediate area is stable.
details: Production pressure to clear the area can disturb physical evidence before the event sequence is understood.
Equipment position, controls, materials and environmental conditions may all help explain the unexpected movement.
The scene should remain controlled long enough to document relevant evidence while keeping people safe.

control_verification_record.title: Witness Evidence Record
control_verification_record.summary: Witnesses remember the event differently and their accounts do not fully agree.
details: Differences between witness accounts are information to resolve, not a reason to select the most confident version.
Separate interviews help preserve independent recollection and distinguish observation from assumption.
Timelines, physical evidence and records can be used to test where accounts agree or conflict.

condition_change_record.title: Maintenance History Finding
condition_change_record.summary: Maintenance records reveal a recurring equipment defect that was absent from the initial witness information.
details: The recurring defect introduces a technical factor that was not part of the first event narrative.
Historical maintenance information may explain why equipment behaviour differed from what operators expected.
The investigation scope should now test how the defect, prior responses and operating controls interacted.

response_record.title: Causal Factors Record
response_record.summary: The investigation identifies operator error, a weak procedure and an unresolved equipment defect.
details: The evidence supports multiple contributing factors rather than a single-person explanation.
Corrective action limited to the operator would leave procedural and equipment weaknesses in place.
Actions should address the human, procedural and technical factors supported by the investigation evidence.

closeout_record.title: Corrective Action Verification Record
closeout_record.summary: Corrective actions are assigned and the equipment repair has been completed.
details: Action assignment is not the same as verified completion or demonstrated effectiveness.
Closure should confirm that required procedural, equipment and organizational actions were actually implemented.
The investigation record should retain the evidence, conclusions and lessons needed to prevent recurrence.

prejob_decision_weak.guidedInsight: Schedule pressure should not replace verification.

safe_completion.title: Safe completion
safe_completion.narrative: The work is completed with controls verified.
safe_completion.keyTurningPoint: The key controls were verified before work continued.

controlled_recovery.title: Controlled recovery
controlled_recovery.narrative: Earlier gaps are recognized and corrected before completion.
controlled_recovery.keyTurningPoint: The team recovered by restoring the control boundary.

major_incident.title: Major incident
major_incident.narrative: Unresolved control gaps lead to a significant modeled outcome.
major_incident.keyTurningPoint: Work continued before the required controls were verified.
